# PC Reborn — Front-end Code Standards (HTML + SCSS + Vanilla JS)

Single source of truth for code-level rules. Business, layout and design-system values come from `pc-reborn-project-context.instructions.md`. Task process comes from `figma-to-code-workflow.instructions.md`.

---

## 1. Stack (strict)

| Area | Rule |
|---|---|
| Markup | HTML5, semantic, W3C-valid |
| Styles | SCSS compiled with **Dart Sass CLI** via npm scripts. `@use` / `@forward` only, never `@import` |
| Scripts | Vanilla JavaScript, ES modules loaded natively (`<script type="module">`), no bundler |
| Forbidden | Next.js, React, Vue, jQuery, Tailwind, Bootstrap, any CSS/JS framework or UI library |
| Angular | Only if a feature genuinely needs it. Propose with a reason and wait for approval (workflow Type D) |
| Dependencies | None added without approval. Dart Sass is the only approved dev dependency |

## 2. Project values

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Units | **px only** for font-size, spacing, radius, borders, icon glyph sizes and breakpoints. Layout tracks use `fr` and `%` (§7.4). Line-height may be unitless. No `rem` / `em` |
| Breakpoints (mobile-first) | base = mobile `< 768px` · `md` = `768px` (tablet) · `lg` = `1200px` (desktop) |
| Container | `width: min(100% - 48px, 1355px)` with `margin-inline: auto` — the only place the 1355px value is written (`layout/_container.scss`). Full layout mapping: project context §5 |
| Fonts | Manrope (UI/body), Instrument Serif (display). Self-hosted WOFF2 in `src/assets/fonts/`. Weights: only those used in Figma type styles |
| Letter spacing | Never. If Figma shows a non-zero value, ignore it and report it |
| Icons | Phosphor Icons **Regular** only, inline SVG, sizes 16 / 20 / 24 / 32px (§8) |
| Browsers | Last 2 versions of Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari; iOS Safari 15+; Android Chrome |
| Language | British English in comments, docs and internal UI copy (colour, personalise). CSS keywords stay as the language requires (`color`) |

## 3. Folder structure

```
package.json                 # Dart Sass + scripts only
scripts/                     # build-html.js, check-scss-tokens.js (no dependencies)
src/
  index.html                 # Homepage
  pages/                     # cp-<slug>.html (category), pdp-<slug>.html (product)
  partials/                  # header.html, footer.html — master copy of shared markup
  scss/
    main.scss                # only @use lines, in the layer order below
    abstracts/               # _tokens _breakpoints _mixins _functions (no CSS output)
    base/                    # _fonts _root _reset _typography _utilities
    layout/                  # _container _grid _header _footer
    components/              # generic core + composite UI: _button _icon _accordion ...
    commerce/                # Wall Art domain: _product-card _format-selector ...
    sections/                # page sections/patterns: _home-hero _cp-format-grid ...
    pages/                   # page-only exceptions (keep near-empty)
  css/main.css               # GENERATED by Sass — never edit by hand
  js/
    main.js                  # imports + init() calls only
    components/ commerce/ sections/ utils/
  assets/images/ icons/ fonts/
docs/                        # see pc-reborn-component-system §8
```

Rules:
- **Layer order (dependency direction):** abstracts → base → layout → components → commerce → sections → pages. A file may depend only on layers to its left. The same applies to `js/`.
- One BEM block = one SCSS partial = at most one JS module, with the same name (`_product-card.scss`, `product-card.js`, class `.product-card`).
- Section names are prefixed with their page (`home-`, `cp-`, `pdp-`) only when used on that page alone. Sections used on several pages have no prefix.
- New partial → add `@use` to `main.scss` in its layer group, alphabetical within the group.
- **Shared markup (header, footer):** `src/partials/` holds the master copy. Until an HTML include step is approved, paste it unchanged into every page and update every page in the same change. Never edit the header/footer in only one page.
- npm scripts:
  ```json
  "lint:tokens": "node scripts/check-scss-tokens.js",
  "build:css": "sass src/scss/main.scss src/css/main.css --style=compressed --no-source-map",
  "build": "npm run lint:tokens && npm run build:css && npm run build:html",
  "watch:css": "sass --watch src/scss/main.scss src/css/main.css"
  ```

## 4. HTML

### 4.1 Document
- `<!DOCTYPE html>`, `<html lang="en-GB">`, `<meta charset="utf-8">`, viewport meta.
- Unique `<title>` and `<meta name="description">`, canonical link, Open Graph and Twitter tags.
- CSS `<link>` in `<head>`. JS via `<script type="module">`. No render-blocking scripts.
- Skip link as the first focusable element, pointing to `<main id="main">`.

### 4.2 Semantics
- Landmarks: `header`, `nav`, `main`, `section`, `article`, `aside`, `footer`. One `<main>` per page.
- A `<section>` must have a heading; otherwise use a `<div>`.
- Exactly one `<h1>` per page. Headings in order with no skipped levels. Choose by structure, not size.
- `<button>` for actions, `<a href>` for navigation, real lists, `<figure>`, `<picture>`, `<time>`. Never a `div`/`span` as a control.
- Several `<nav>` elements each need a unique `aria-label`.

### 4.3 Classes, hooks and attributes
- BEM: `block`, `block__element`, `block--modifier`; lowercase, hyphenated.
- JS hooks use `data-js="name"` only. Never style a `data-js` hook; never script off a styling class.
- IDs only for anchors, label `for` and ARIA references — never for styling.
- No inline styles, no inline event handlers. Lowercase attributes, double quotes.
- Keep markup flat: no wrapper `div` without a layout reason.

### 4.4 Section comments (required)
```html
<!-- ==========================================================
     HOME HERO | Lifestyle image, headline, finish preview, CTA
     ========================================================== -->
<section class="home-hero" aria-labelledby="home-hero-title">
  <!-- Hero CTA -->
  ...
</section>
<!-- /HOME HERO -->
```
- Banner comment opens every top-level landmark/section; `<!-- /NAME -->` closes it.
- Sub-blocks get a one-line comment. No commented-out code.

### 4.5 Images
- Meaningful `alt`; decorative images `alt=""`.
- Always `width` and `height` attributes. Use `aspect-ratio` on the frame; `object-fit: cover` only when the crop does not misrepresent the product.
- `<picture>` with AVIF/WebP and a fallback; `srcset` + `sizes`.
- Below the fold: `loading="lazy"` `decoding="async"`. LCP image: no lazy, `fetchpriority="high"`.
- No text baked into images. No important content in CSS background images.

### 4.6 Forms
- Every control has a visible `<label for>`. Placeholders are not labels.
- Correct `type`, `name`, `autocomplete`, `inputmode`, `required`. Group with `<fieldset>` + `<legend>`.
- Errors: linked with `aria-describedby`, announced (`aria-live="polite"` or `role="alert"`), never colour alone.

## 5. SEO
- Title 50–60 characters, description 140–160 characters, unique per page.
- Descriptive link text; never "click here" or a bare "read more".
- Real content is in the HTML, not injected by JS.
- JSON-LD where relevant: `Organization`, `WebSite`, `BreadcrumbList`, `Product`. Never invent prices, ratings or stock — verified data only (project context §2).
- Breadcrumbs on CP and PDP.
- Core Web Vitals: LCP < 2.5s, CLS < 0.1, INP < 200ms.

## 6. Accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA)
- Native HTML first; ARIA only when needed and correct.
- Contrast: 4.5:1 normal text; 3:1 large text (24px, or 18.66px bold), UI components, icons and focus indicators.
- `:focus-visible` on every interactive element. Never remove an outline without a visible replacement.
- Fully keyboard-operable; DOM order = tab order; no positive `tabindex`.
- Target size ≥ 24 × 24px; 44 × 44px on touch (pad small icons).
- Colour never the only signal of state.
- Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`; no auto-motion over 5 seconds without a pause control.
- Icon-only controls have an accessible name.
- Keep `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`, `aria-current`, `aria-pressed` in sync with JS state.
- Menus/dialogs: focus moves in on open, trapped in modals, `Esc` closes, focus returns to the trigger.
- 200% zoom without loss; no horizontal scroll at 320px.
- Screen-reader-only text uses `.visually-hidden`, never `display: none`.

## 7. SCSS

### 7.1 Tokens
- Every colour, font, type size, radius, shadow, z-index and duration comes from a token; spacing comes from the `--space-*` scale (off-scale rule below). No raw hex in components.
- Token tiers, naming and ownership: `pc-reborn-component-system` §5.
- **Custom properties are design tokens only:** `--color-*`, `--font-*`, `--line-height-*`, `--space-<n>` (the shared spacing scale: 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 32, 36, 48, 88), `--radius-*`, `--motion-*`, `--layer-*`. `npm run lint:tokens` enforces this and runs as part of `npm run build`.
- **Never a variable for a layout dimension:** no width, height, min/max size, offset, column track, gap or aspect ratio of one component or section (for example a hero height, an image width or a header link gap). Figma frame measurements are references, not tokens.
- **Spacing** (padding, margin, gap) uses the `--space-*` scale. Map an off-scale Figma value to the nearest scale token and record the difference in `docs/CHANGELOG.md`; never add a variable for it. A local px literal is only for a detail inside one control (hairline, underline offset, optical padding), never for page or section structure.
- Colour, type, radius, motion and layer tokens mirror Figma variables, even when only one component uses them.

### 7.2 Mobile-first breakpoints
```scss
// abstracts/_breakpoints.scss
@use 'sass:map';

$breakpoints: (
  'md': 768px,   // tablet
  'lg': 1200px   // desktop
);

@mixin up($key) {
  @media (min-width: map.get($breakpoints, $key)) {
    @content;
  }
}
```
- Base styles = mobile. Enhance upward with `@include up('md')` / `@include up('lg')` only.
- Never `max-width` queries or raw pixel values in media queries.
- Hover styles go inside `@media (hover: hover)`.

### 7.3 Rules
- Nesting max 3 levels, using `&__element` / `&--modifier`. No ID or tag-qualified selectors.
- One block per partial. No cross-component overrides — use a modifier on the owning block.
- Pattern repeated 3+ times → `@mixin`, `%placeholder` or utility.
- States where relevant: `:hover`, `:focus-visible`, `:active`, `:disabled`, `[aria-invalid]`, `[aria-expanded]`.
- Layout: flexbox (1-D) or grid (2-D) with `gap`, not sibling margins. Logical properties (`margin-inline`, `padding-block`).
- `aspect-ratio` for media. No fixed or minimum heights: size by content, `padding` and `gap` (§7.4).
- Animate only `transform` and `opacity`, 150–300ms, disabled under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- `!important` only in utilities, with a comment.
- Property order: positioning → display/box → typography → visual → misc → states → responsive.
- Partial header comment:
  ```scss
  // ==========================================================
  // PRODUCT CARD | Wall Art product tile
  // ==========================================================
  ```

### 7.4 Fluid layout (no fixed layout dimensions)
Pages are fluid from 320px to beyond 1600px. Figma's 1600px frames are the reference, not a page width. Layout comes from structure, never from measured sizes.
- **Widths:** grid/flex tracks (`repeat(n, minmax(0, 1fr))`, `fr` ratios such as `2fr 3fr`), `gap`, `padding` and `margin`. No fixed `width`/`height` on sections, grids, columns or cards, and no fixed pixel tracks such as `minmax(200px, 1fr)`.
- **The container is the only fixed content width** (`min(100% - 48px, 1355px)`). Other literals are limited to the 320px page minimum (`body`), the search dialog (720px wide, 120px from the top), icon glyphs and icon cells (14–32px) and 1px hairlines. Label/value columns use `max-content` + `minmax(0, 1fr)`, never a fixed label width.
- **Heights:** content + `padding-block` + `gap`. Never `height`/`min-height` to reproduce a Figma frame height — fixed frame heights in Figma are usually unused space; ignore them. Equal-height cards come from grid stretch; keep inner rows aligned with `flex: 1` / `margin-top: auto`.
- **Controls:** size by `padding` + `line-height` (button: 16 + 20 + 16 = 52px; 44px touch target: 12px padding around a 20px icon), not `min-height`, `width` or `height`.
- **Media:** `aspect-ratio` on the image slot with `width: 100%`, so space is reserved and nothing is distorted.
- **Positioning:** no absolute `top`/`left` offsets for page structure. Absolute positioning is only for overlays on a media frame (badge, finish selector).
- **Viewport units:** use `100%`, never `100vw` (it includes the scrollbar and causes horizontal scroll).
- **Reflow:** every row must wrap or stack below its breakpoint. Verify 320px has no horizontal scroll before finishing.

## 8. Icons (Phosphor Regular, inline SVG)
- Match every Figma icon to Phosphor **Regular** (https://phosphoricons.com, SVGs at https://github.com/phosphor-icons/core). If Figma shows a different weight or a non-Phosphor icon, use the Figma export and report the mismatch.
- Inline SVG only — no `<img>` icons, icon fonts or CSS background icons. A hidden inline sprite (`<symbol>` + `<use>`) is allowed for icons repeated on a page.
- Keep `viewBox="0 0 256 256"`, `fill="currentColor"`. Remove `width`/`height`, `style`, `id`, `class`, `<title>` and editor metadata.
- Every SVG has a comment with the icon name: `<!-- Phosphor: shopping-cart, regular -->`.
- Decorative / next to text: `aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"`. Icon-only control: name on the control (`aria-label`). Standalone meaningful icon: `role="img" aria-label="…"`.
- Sizes via CSS only: `.icon` = 24px, `.icon--sm` = 16px, `.icon--md` = 20px, `.icon--lg` = 32px.

## 9. JavaScript
- `const` by default, `let` when needed, never `var`. Strict equality. No globals.
- One module per block in `js/<layer>/`, exporting `init(root = document)`. `main.js` only imports and calls `init()`.
- Query by `[data-js="…"]` scoped to the component root; support multiple instances; guard missing elements (`if (!el) return;`); prevent double initialisation.
- Event delegation for repeated items. `{ passive: true }` on scroll/touch. Debounce/throttle resize and scroll; prefer `IntersectionObserver` / `ResizeObserver`.
- State lives in classes plus ARIA/`hidden`/`data-` attributes — never inline styles.
- Keyboard support appropriate to the pattern (Enter, Space, Esc, arrows, Home, End).
- Progressive enhancement: content and navigation work without JS where possible. Do not use JS for what CSS or native HTML does (`details/summary`, `:checked`, sticky, scroll-snap).
- No `innerHTML` with untrusted data — use `textContent` or create elements.
- `fetch` with `try/catch` and visible user feedback. No `console.log` left behind.
- JSDoc on exported functions. Section banner comment at the top of each module.

## 10. Performance
- No layout shift: reserve space for images, embeds and fonts.
- Fonts: WOFF2, `font-display: swap`, preload the primary Manrope weight, system fallback stack.
- Images: AVIF/WebP, correct dimensions, `srcset`, lazy below the fold. Production images are served via the Raven CDN (project context §12).
- DOM: no more than 4 nested wrapper `div`s. Shallow selectors.
- Lighthouse target: 90+ in Performance, Accessibility, Best Practices and SEO.

## 11. Code review output (workflow Type B)
Review against every section above. Do not rewrite working code for style preference — flag it.
```
## Summary
Status: Pass / Pass with changes / Fail — one or two lines.

## Findings
### Critical | ### High | ### Medium | ### Low
- [file:line] Rule (§) · Problem · Customer/technical impact · Fix (code)

## Figma mismatches
- Element · Figma value · Code value

## Missing in Figma
- States, breakpoints or content not defined

## Checks run
- Command/tool → result (or "not run: reason")
```
Severity scale is defined in project context §11.
